sources.title: https://www.bothellwa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/18694/Chapter-3---Streets-and-Related-Work
sources.supports: Design and Construction Standards ch.3: 3-4.2.6 driveways (16 ft approach, Table 3-1, safety island, corner/curb return, infrastructure, 15% grade, no encroachment, parking on private property); 3-16 sidewalk joints, rain cover, WSDOT/APWA curing, longitudinal broom at driveway crossings, no calcium chloride; 3-18 cement concrete driveway (Class 3000, slump <=3 in, 6 in apron over 4 in CSTC 95% MDD, inspector approval, center expansion joint >15 ft, full curb/gutter removal, 6 ft curb between adjacent-lot driveways, neighbor co-sign)

sources.title: https://www.bothellwa.gov/DocumentCenter/View/18695/Chapter-4---Storm-Drainage
sources.supports: Design and Construction Standards ch.4: service area = city limits; KCSWDM adopted; target surfaces 5,000 sf / 50% language; Sammamish River quarter-mile infiltration; landslide hazard areas; pervious pavement not in ROW without deviation; permeable pavement roadway sections and 3,000 psi; LID performance testing; plastic grid pavers; wheel strip driveways; backwater valves
